description: Verify that TCP in FIN-WAIT-1 returns ACK with proper SEQ/ACK numbers after receiving a segment with OTW SEQ or unacceptable ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p37)
approach:
[Objective]
FW1's response to OTW-SEQ / unacc-ACK is identical to ESTABLISHED's: corrective ACK announcing the expected SEQ. 2 phases test the OTW-SEQ and unacc-ACK shapes.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases. For each:
1. Handshake → CLOSE → FW1.
2. Tester sends OTW-SEQ (phase 1) or unacc-ACK (phase 2) data.
3. DUT must emit corrective ACK.

[Pass condition]
Both phases produce corrective ACKs.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: handshake / FIN / data ACK missing.

verdicts.Pass: DUT corrective-acked in FW1 (OTW + unacc) — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ in FW1
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to unacceptable ACK in FW1
